scope: Initial launcher contracts used an isolated preseeded debug binary. Release smoke checks installed the exact checksummed GitHub npm tarball, downloaded its real macOS arm64 executable into a temporary cache, and ran both public-registry launchers. The installed OsmoGrep application was not replaced.
native_ui_scope: Private pseudo-terminal, real released macOS arm64 binary, one local fake-model response, zero paid calls. Physical mouse-to-clipboard interaction was not repeated.
